messages:
PagerBot: ALERT — p99 spike detected on /v1/chat/completions (route=chat-primary, model=redwood/mistral-8x, region=us-west-2). p99=1400ms, p95=700ms. Alert fired: latency.p99 > 1200ms for 3m
Anya Patel: I'm paged, looking now. seeing steady low QPS but a few very long seq requests. not a full capacity issue.
T.J. Morgan: FYI some customers hit long-context feature this morning — could be a tail latency + kvcache miss pattern.
Anya Patel: trying a quick mitigation: switch chat-primary routing for mistral-8x -> mistral-8x-quant (lower perf variability). will watch latency/err rates.
Mike Chen: good call. if that reduces p99 we can then tune alert thresholds instead of suppressing. keep an eye on errors.
ops-bot: @Anya Patel routing change applied: chat-primary -> chat-primary-fallback (mistral-8x-quant).
Anya Patel: confirmed: p99 dropped to ~520ms on the fallback path within 60s. overall p99 for route down to 600ms. no increase in 5xx. :relieved:
Eva Rodríguez: that's promising. can we make a short-term alert adjustment to avoid pager churn while we investigate root cause? propose: mute p99 PagerDuty for chat-primary for 30m, keep slack notifications.
T.J. Morgan: +1 to mute PD. but let's not lose observability — keep historical recording.
Luc Nguyen: I'll add short-term dashboard panels to split p95/p99 by model variant and by route. will post link when ready.
Anya Patel: creating an immediate mitigation checklist in the thread so oncall handoffs know what we did and why:
- routing fallback -> mistral-8x-quant (timestamped)
- PD mute for p99 (30m)
- dashboards added: p95/p99 by model/route + kvcache miss rate panel
- capture traces for long-gen requests
T.J. Morgan: tagging customers impacted so support can proactively reach out. please add customer IDs to the incident tracker.
Mike Chen: action item: short-term alert config change proposal below. we'll revert to strict paging after next deploy with better per-model thresholds.
```yaml
# temporary alert damping (example)
alert: ChatCompletionsP99NoiseDamped
expr: |
  (
    histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le,model)) > 1.6
    and sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) > 20
  )
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/chat-p99
```
Anya Patel: Proposed permanent plan (for postmortem): per-model/per-route thresholds + noise gating. e.g., mistral-8x p99 = 1.6s, mistral-8x-quant p99 = 1.4s, small models p99 = 0.9s. also add volume floor: only page if route QPS > 10 over 5m.
Eva Rodríguez: +1 on volume floor. low-volume routes often cause noisy pages. we should also add automatic reroute policy to fallback variant for >95th percentile long-tail events.
Luc Nguyen: Dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/chat-latency-split — added panels for per-model p95/p99, request_count, kvcache_miss_ratio, and long-gen traces. live now.
Anya Patel: I'm going to leave the PD mute and escalate to oncall handoff in 25m with this thread summary. If handoff happens, include the mitigation steps and the dashboard link.
ops-bot: Pagination reminder: Handoff window starts at 2419876763.
T.J. Morgan: For the post-incident followups, suggest owners:
- root cause & kernel analysis: Mike Chen
- alert rule rewrite & deployment: Eva Rodríguez
- dashboard consolidation & runbook updates: Luc Nguyen
- customer comms: T.J. Morgan + Support
Anya Patel: adding a short runbook note here for future quick mitigations:
1) Check per-model p99 panels
2) If model-specific tail, route to quantized fallback with low-latency profile
3) If route QPS < 10, consider suppressing PD and escalate to slack-only
4) Add traces and tag affected customer IDs
Mike Chen: we'll plan a gradual rollout of new alert rules behind a feature flag so we can A/B the thresholds per region. I'll own the PR.
Eva Rodríguez: leaving a small follow-up: create a metric that counts pages suppressed by volume-floor so we can audit missed incidents.
Anya Patel: thanks everyone. handing off to T.J. in 15. final status: routing fallback active, p99 back under target, PD suppressed for 30m, dashboards live.
T.J. Morgan: oncall ack. will monitor next 2 hours and then unmute PD if stable.
PagerBot: Incident note: mitigation applied and PD suppressed temporarily. Logging incident state to #incidents-log.
Luc Nguyen: created ticket INC-241987-ALERT-REWRITE for permanent rule changes and dashboard improvements.
Mike Chen: postmortem owner assigned: Mike Chen. ETA for report: 48h.
Anya Patel: closing thread on my side, will append handoff notes to the ticket. Thanks all. :v:
